[EN] Mission Orders

We need to take out some of the lesser argons near the {@Rgn:45002$$Tower Approach} in {@Rgn:45001$$Thrallhold}.

Kill {@LinkCreature:45#1001#kelba chargers}, {@LinkCreature:45#1002#argonomorph dwarf orcans}, and {@LinkCreature:45#1003#argonomorph runekeepers}.

Report to Laetesha at Pathfinder Post when mission is complete.
[ES] Órdenes de misión

Tenemos que eliminar a algunos de los argons menores cerca de {@Rgn:45002$$Tower Approach} en {@Rgn:45001$$Thrallhold}.

Mata a {@LinkCreature:45#1001#kelba chargers}, {@LinkCreature:45#1002#argonomorph dwarf orcans} y {@LinkCreature:45#1003#argonomorph runekeepers}.

Reportate con Laetesha en Pathfinder Post cuando la misión esté completa.

[EN] You've earned the thanks of the federation. Your guild is an inspiration to all!
[ES] Te has ganado el agradecimiento de la federación. ¡Tu hermandad es una inspiración para todos!

[EN] It looks like you haven't completed your mission yet.
[ES] Parece que aún no has completado tu misión.
